About Me

    

      

        
Hi, there! I am currently a senior machine learning engineer at Meta, working on Instagram recommendation systems. Ex @ TikTok, Tencent Game, Lightspeed & Quantum Studios Group.
Prior to this, I obtained my M.S. degree from UC San Diego,
advised by Prof. Pengtao Xie and Prof. Julian McAuley,
and my B.E. degree from Northwestern Polytechnical University(NPU), respectively.



My research interest includes Applied Machine Learning in recommender system and game industry.
